The phrase is the only way in, the settings speak the family's design language, and rainbow mode is finally visible.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Connecting is the phrase, full stop.** The name-and-address form is gone, exactly as it went from the browser extension: twelve words, and every instance in the group appears. What the old form uniquely carried goes with it, named rather than lost silently — the address QR and hand-typed token entry. A connection saved back when that path existed keeps working; there is just no way to create another one.
- **The settings look like the product they configure.** Cards carry their titles as notch badges on the top edge, the theme and corner pickers are the family's well selector — a groove in which only the chosen segment is a badge — following the instance is a real switch, and not a single drawn border is left on the page. The cards each own a rainbow position, so the mode reaches the settings themselves.
- **Rainbow mode can actually be seen.** It was applied correctly the whole time, at a wash so faint nobody registers it — the exact 7% the design language's own changelog documents as having drawn three independent "the mode does nothing" reports on the web before being raised. Rows now wash at 16%, and the running row at 22%.
- **"Follow the instance" fetches the instance's look at the moment you flip it**, rather than showing whatever was fetched when the app started. Flipping it off keeps what you see and simply makes it yours to edit.
- **The language list marks the chosen row by fill**, not by an outline — the one drawn border that had survived on that screen.

## 📋 Notes

- Twelve connect-form strings left all 42 languages with the removed screen.
